description: Screen a person, company, vessel or aircraft name against the OFAC SDN and Consolidated, EU, UN Security Council and UK sanctions lists (official files, refreshed daily). Fuzzy matching with aliases and transliteration; an optional country and date of birth sharpen the score. Returns each possible match with list, entry ID, score, programmes and official link. A new name takes about 20 to 75 s (allow 120 s); repeats come from a 6-hour cache. A screening aid, not a legal determination. Price: $0.01 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: Country or nationality, ISO code or name (optional, raises or lowers the score)

dob.description: Date of birth for a person: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY (optional)

lists.description: Comma-separated lists, default all: ofac-sdn, ofac-consolidated, eu-sanctions-map, un-consolidated, uk-sanctions

name.description: Name to screen (person, company, vessel or aircraft), up to 200 characters

threshold.description: Match threshold 50-100, default 85 (lower finds more and more false alarms)

type.description: person or entity (optional, sharpens the score)

name: sanctions
title: Check a name against OFAC, EU, UN and UK sanctions lists
